headline: Visual Designer
tagline: Graphic Designer experienced in producing digital and print creatives, brand guidelines, and marketing collaterals.

skills.label: Visual Design
skills.items: Branding and Visual Identity, Typography, Layout, Print Production, Social and Marketing Creatives

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Managed print-ready files including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy for marketing collateral.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders to maintain low revision cycles.
Applied typography, colour systems, layout, and visual hierarchy across diverse communication requirements.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to user flows and interface usability.

projects.name: Branding kit for AT Creation startup
bullets: Developed logo, typography, and color palette demonstrating core visual identity and branding execution.

projects.name: Social campaign for a fashion brand
bullets: Created Instagram and Facebook series resulting in a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her recent graphic design experience at Ascent Business Solutions producing over 100 digital and print employer branding and marketing creatives, aligned with the Black & Grey HR graphic design requirements.
